Kya hum ne aap ke seene ko kushaada nahin kiya
Aur kya aap ke bojh ko utaar nahin liya
Jis ne aap ki kamar ko tod diya tha
Aur aap ke zikr ko buland kar diya
Haan zehmat ke saath aasaani bhi hai
Be-shak takleef ke saath sahoolat bhi hai
Lehaaza jab aap faarigh ho jaayen to nasb kar dein
Aur apne Rabb ki taraf rukh karein
